verdict: A deployment-type script is not signed, and the client's PowerShell execution policy requires signed scripts.
fix: Either sign the script with a code-signing certificate that the clients trust (internal CA), or set `Client Settings / Computer Agent / PowerShell execution policy` to `Bypass` so MECM-originated scripts run regardless of the OS policy. Bypass is the house-standard for admin-authored scripts since MECM already gates what runs.
